# `company.pick_lists`

Pick lists: which units of which open orders to take from which bins at one site. Immutable; its state is its newest revision.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this pick list. |
| `number` | VARCHAR(64) | no | — | unique | — | — | Pick list number, from the pick_list sequence (P-1, P-2, ...). |
| `site_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | inventory_sites.id | Inventory site the units are picked at. |
| `pick_date` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | — | — | Date the list is for, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `picker` | VARCHAR(200) | yes | — | — | — | — | Who picks it: a user or free text; null when nobody was named. |
| `memo` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Memo as entered; null when blank. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this pick list was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that recorded this pick list. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that recorded this pick list. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this pick list. |
